date: "2026-10-20"
output:
  html_document:
    toc: true
    toc_float: true
---

Input: `Working/objects_<run>/global.rds`, which carries the cell types from step 10 and the B states from step 15.
Output: figures in `Figures/<run>/`, tables in `Tables/<run>/`. This step only plots, it does not change the object.

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = if (basename(getwd()) == "Analysis") normalizePath("..") else getwd())
knitr::opts_chunk$set(message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
source(if (file.exists("_setup.R")) "_setup.R" else "Analysis/_setup.R")
```

## Global cell types

```{r global_bars}
obj <- readRDS(gfile)
cnt <- count_frac(obj@meta.data, "cell_type")
write.csv(cnt, file.path(tab, "step20_celltype_counts_per_sample.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
p_ct <- lab_bars(cnt, "cell_type", ct_cols) & big
ggsave(file.path(fig, "step20_01_celltype_counts_fractions_per_sample.pdf"), p_ct, width = 13, height = 6)
p_ct
cnt |> group_by(cell_type) |> summarise(cells = sum(n), pct = round(100 * sum(n) / sum(cnt$n), 1))
```

## Major lineages

```{r major_bars}
major <- c("B cells" = "B cells", "CD4 T cells" = "T cells", "CD8 T cells" = "T cells", "Gamma delta T cells" = "T cells", "NK cells" = "NK cells",
           "Monocytes" = "Myeloid", "DCs" = "Myeloid", "Neutrophils" = "Myeloid", "Eosinophils" = "Myeloid", "Platelet-bound cells" = "Platelet-bound")
maj_cols <- c("B cells" = "#1F77B4", "T cells" = "#2CA02C", "NK cells" = "#D62728", "Myeloid" = "#FF7F0E", "Platelet-bound" = "#F7B6D2")
cm <- obj@meta.data |> filter(cell_type %in% names(major)) |> mutate(major = factor(major[as.character(cell_type)], names(maj_cols))) |> count_frac("major")
write.csv(cm, file.path(tab, "step20_major_lineage_counts_per_sample.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
p_maj <- lab_bars(cm, "major", maj_cols) & big
ggsave(file.path(fig, "step20_02_major_lineage_counts_fractions_per_sample.pdf"), p_maj, width = 12, height = 5.5)
p_maj
cm |> group_by(major) |> summarise(cells = sum(n), pct = round(100 * sum(n) / sum(cm$n), 1))
```

## B cell states

```{r b_bars}
b <- sub_umap(obj, colnames(obj)[!is.na(obj$B_subtype_detail)], "b_umap_1", "b_umap_2")
bcd <- count_frac(b@meta.data, "B_subtype_detail")
write.csv(bcd, file.path(tab, "step20_B_state_counts_per_sample.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
p_b <- lab_bars(bcd, "B_subtype_detail", bd_cols, min_frac = .04) & big
ggsave(file.path(fig, "step20_03_B_state_counts_fractions_per_sample.pdf"), p_b, width = 13, height = 6)
p_b
p_bumap <- DimPlot(b, group.by = "B_subtype_detail", cols = bd_cols, label = TRUE, repel = TRUE, label.size = 4, raster = TRUE) + ggtitle(NULL) + labs(x = "UMAP 1", y = "UMAP 2") + big
ggsave(file.path(fig, "step20_04_umap_B_states.pdf"), p_bumap, width = 9, height = 7)
p_bumap
bcd |> group_by(B_subtype_detail) |> summarise(cells = sum(n), pct_of_B = round(100 * sum(n) / sum(bcd$n), 1))
```
